heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 95–626, title II, § 208(b), Nov. 10, 1978, 92 Stat. 3588

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 91–695, title II, § 201, Jan. 13, 1971, 84 Stat. 2078; Pub. L. 93–151, § 2, Nov. 9, 1973, 87 Stat. 565, related to the development of local programs for the elimination of lead-based paint poisoning.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Pub. L. 95–626, title II, § 208(b), Nov. 10, 1978, 92 Stat. 3588, provided that the repeal of this section is effective Oct. 1, 1979.
